scope: Two development repetitions of one previously observed task; no independent task sample or method-effect estimate
hypotheses: The search-to-read controller executes actual reads from both required papers and delivers a structurally and citation-valid report within the frozen budget.
transport_billing_note: Unknown or retried transport cost is not independently recoverable.
independent_variables: None within this gate; both repetitions use the currently repaired controller. No new focus or memory implementation.
baseline_scope: Earlier failed runs are historical diagnostics. This gate repeats one already-seen development task and cannot establish generalization or quality gains.
freeze_rule: No code, prompt, input, rubric or budget edits between the two repetitions. Retain all outcomes.
stopping_rule: Exactly two planned attempts; no replacement of failures. Stop early only for unknown billing, missing access or an external service fault; record missing outcomes.
mechanical_checks: citations are canonical reads from this run
both required papers have actual reads
eight requirements retained; field presence is not correctness
descriptive_metrics: read ranges extending after line 50, explicitly a location proxy only
next_stage: After both attempts, diagnose all outcomes. Any new architecture condition requires a separately frozen plan. No automatic replacement of failed attempts.
